caption: Ferry terminal, Holwerd
composition: Empty Wadden pier and dark berth at the Ameland ferry terminal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the dike at Holwerd the concrete pier and steel ramps run out to an empty berth on the Wadden Sea. No ferry is alongside after midnight. The terminal is a low dark block with a few lamps. The sky is partly cloudy, about 12.1°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h and no rain. Sunset was 19:25. The channel is dark water; a measured tide was not retrieved.
